question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become supported public plugin-SDK API for transient progress delivery policy?
rationale: The cross-plugin typed seam is cleaner than Slack text inference, but adding public callable SDK surface is a lasting compatibility choice that repository history and CI cannot approve automatically.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
options.body: Keep the narrow additive constant and predicate, document their transient-progress purpose, and require channel implementations to preserve the typed intent.

options.title: Use a narrower internal seam
options.body: Remove the new public exports and introduce an approved bundled-plugin-only contract if third-party plugins should not depend on this policy.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Pause this PR if channel transports should not suppress messages based on producer-supplied progress metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow additive constant and predicate, document their transient-progress purpose, and require channel implementations to preserve the typed intent.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns both the reply-payload contract and Slack native block delivery most directly.
